entities.summary: Kyle Joseph Guy is an American professional basketball player for the Shanxi Loongs of the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA). He played college basketball for the Virginia Cavaliers as a shooting guard for three years and was named the NCAA Tournament Most Outstanding Player during his junior season en route to winning the NCAA Championship. In high school, he was Indiana Mr. Basketball and a McDonald's All-American.
